definitions: A celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy, typically visible as a luminous point in the night sky.
A conventionalized representation of a star, typically having five or more points.
A famous or exceptionally talented entertainer or sportsperson.
A principal actor or performer in a film, play, or show.
An asterisk (*), used to draw attention to a note or to indicate an omission.
A person's fate or fortune as supposedly influenced by the stars.
examples: The night sky was full of stars.
The star of the show took a bow.
See the note marked with a star.
Her star was on the rise.
